metadata.description: Named after the many boulders which are natural to the site, Boulder Creek Golf Club is an 18-hole championship caliber golf course on approximately 200 acres which are devoted exclusively to the golf course.  With it's breathtaking vistas, Boulder Creek is already being touted by golf industry insiders as one of View Our Current Television CommercialOhio's top daily fee golf courses. The layout includes an island green on #17, a split fairway par 5 and features two major waterfalls playable from five sets of tees.

metadata.description: The natural beauty of the land, enhanced by Rattlesnake Creek, provides the ultimate in topography for this challenging golf course. Stretching to over 7,000 yards from the Championship Tees, this is a course where club selection and shot making ability are rewarded.  Opened in 2001, the course is known for its excellent greens and immaculate conditions. It provides a pure golf experience in a beautiful, quiet rural setting. A beautiful new clubhouse, overlooking the 18th green, opened May 5, 2006. Rattlesnake Ridge will soon be recognized as the best affordable golf-only private club in Central Ohio. Several attractive membership plans are now available.

metadata.description: Yankee Run Golf Course is where you will find a golf experience that is challenging yet relaxing. The picturesque layout of our 77 year old golf course in Northeast Ohio is a beauty to behold and a pleasure to play. For three generations the McMullin family has operated Yankee Run Golf Course. Our mature, superbly maintained golf facility is set on 150 acres of rolling terrain. Experience an unmatched round of golf that can only be found at Yankee Run.
